DESCRIPTION ǀ DESCRIPCIÓN ǀ ОПИСАНИЕ ǀ ↓↓↓↓↓↓

↓   ENGLISH     ↓  
The Panama amazon, also known as the Panama yellow-headed amazon, (Amazona ochrocephala panamensis) is a subspecies of the yellow-crowned amazon, and is endemic to Panama (including the Pearl Islands and Coiba) and northwest Colombia. In aviculture, it is sometimes listed as a separate species (Amazona panamensis), and this is potentially correct; at least as a phylogenetic species.
Adults are approximately 35 centimetres (13.8 in) in length, are bright green with a yellow area on the forehead, and a horn-colored (gray) beak, sometimes with a dark tip, but lacking the reddish coloring on the upper mandible that is present in the nominate yellow-crowned amazon. The plumage of the body is green with a little coloring at the brims of the wings. The yellow on the crown is more restricted, and tends to be triangular, compared with the more extensive and rounder distribution of yellow on the nominate race. There is much variation in coloring among individuals. 
Because they are highly sought after as pets and because of trapping of wild birds, which is now illegal, there has been a population decline. This has made them difficult to find. Panama amazons are extremely playful, can be excellent talkers and tend to be loud at times; much like the (nominate) yellow-crowned, yellow-headed and yellow-naped amazons. Though their body language is the same, Panama amazons are much less likely to become physically aggressive. Many other amazon parrots are erroneously sold as Panama amazons, because of their scarcity and popularity.😊

↓   ESPAÑOL   ↓ 
 
La amazona de Panamá, también conocida como amazona de cabeza amarilla de Panamá (Amazona ochrocephala panamensis) es una subespecie de la amazona de corona amarilla y es endémica de Panamá (incluidas las Islas de las Perlas y Coiba) y el noroeste de Colombia. En avicultura, a veces se la incluye como una especie separada (Amazona panamensis), y esto es potencialmente correcto; al menos como especie filogenética.
Los adultos miden aproximadamente 35 centímetros (13,8 pulgadas) de largo, son de color verde brillante con un área amarilla en la frente y un pico de color cuerno (gris), a veces con una punta oscura, pero que carece del color rojizo en la mandíbula superior que es presente en la amazona nominada de corona amarilla. El plumaje del cuerpo es verde con un poco de coloración en el borde de las alas. El amarillo en la corona es más restringido y tiende a ser triangular, en comparación con la distribución más extensa y redonda del amarillo en la raza nominada. Hay mucha variación en la coloración entre los individuos.
Debido a que son muy buscados como mascotas y debido a la captura de aves silvestres, que ahora es ilegal, se ha producido una disminución de la población. Esto ha hecho que sea difícil encontrarlos. Las amazonas de Panamá son extremadamente juguetonas, pueden ser excelentes conversadoras y a veces tienden a ser ruidosas; muy parecido a las amazonas (nominadas) de corona amarilla, cabeza amarilla y nuca amarilla. Aunque su lenguaje corporal es el mismo, es mucho menos probable que las amazonas panameñas se vuelvan físicamente agresivas. Muchos otros loros amazónicos se venden erróneamente como amazonas de Panamá, debido a su escasez y popularidad.😊

↓   РУССКИЙ   ↓  

Панамская амазонка, также известная как Панамская желтоголовая амазонка (Amazona ochrocephala panamensis) является подвидом желтокоронной амазонки и является эндемиком Панамы (включая Жемчужные острова и Койбу) и северо-западной Колумбии. В птицеводстве его иногда выделяют в отдельный вид (Amazona panamensis), и это потенциально правильно; по крайней мере, как филогенетический вид.
Взрослые особи имеют длину около 35 сантиметров (13,8 дюйма), ярко-зеленые с желтой областью на лбу и клювом рогового (серого) цвета, иногда с темным кончиком, но без красноватой окраски на верхней челюсти. присутствует у номинативной амазонки с желтой короной. Оперение тела зеленое с небольшой окраской по краям крыльев. Желтый цвет на макушке более ограничен и имеет тенденцию быть треугольным по сравнению с более обширным и округлым распределением желтого цвета у номинальной расы. Окраска у разных особей сильно различается.
Поскольку их очень любят в качестве домашних животных, а из-за отлова диких птиц, который сейчас запрещен, популяция сократилась. Это затруднило их поиск. Панамские амазонки чрезвычайно игривы, могут быть отличными собеседниками и иногда бывают громкими; очень похоже на (номинальных) амазонок с желтой короной, желтой головой и желтым ворсом. Хотя язык тела у них одинаковый, панамские амазонки гораздо реже становятся физически агрессивными. comments:
The Australian Wood Duck has adapted to modified environments remarkably well. You are just as Australian Wood Ducks loafing at the edge of a farm dam or ornamental pond as beside a swamp, or swimming on a reservoir as on a lake, or foraging on a golf course or in green pasture as in a water meadow or grassland. They even sometimes build their nests in chimneys instead of tree hollows. This level of adaptability has allowed the species to expand its range greatly since Europeans colonised Australia.\

Description

The Australian Wood Duck is a medium-sized 'goose-like' duck with a dark brown head and a pale grey body with two black stripes along the back. Males have the darker head and a small dark mane, with a speckled brown-grey breast and a black lower belly and undertail. The females have a paler head with two white stripes, above and below the eye, a speckled breast and flanks, with a white lower belly and undertail. In flight, the wings are pale grey above, contrasting with black wingtips, and have a noticeable white bar on the underside (the secondaries). They walk easily on land and may be seen perching on logs and in trees. They will only take to open water when disturbed. This species is also known as the Maned Duck or the Maned Goose.

Similar Species

The Australian Wood Duck can be distinguished from pygmy geese,Nettapus spp, which are smaller, have bold white face markings and are usually seen on water. Whistling ducks, Dendrocygna spp, have longer legs and necks, larger more duck-like bills and tend to walk more upright. When flying, the Australian Wood Duck is the only duck with white secondary feathers and dark wingtips.

Distribution

The Australian Wood Duck is widespread in Australia, including Tasmania.

Habitat

The Australian Wood Duck is found in grasslands, open woodlands, wetlands, flooded pastures and along the coast in inlets and bays. It is also common on farmland with dams, as well as around rice fields, sewage ponds and in urban parks. It will often be found around deeper lakes that may be unsuitable for other waterbirds' foraging, as it prefers to forage on land.

Feeding

The Australian Wood Duck eats grasses, clover and other herbs, and occasionally, insects. It is rarely seen on open water, preferring to forage by dabbling in shallow water, or in grasslands and crops.

Breeding

The Australian Wood Duck forms monogamous breeding pairs that stay together year round. It nests in tree holes, above or near water, often re-using the same site. Both parents feed young and young birds remain with them up to a month after fledging.

En Asturias hace tiempo que detecto que comienza también a ser un problema y coincido en que los escasos ejemplares que quedarán en estado natural por nuestros bosques correrán el riesgo de desaparecer. En algunos viajes por Madrid (jardines de Aranjuez) y Sevilla he observado varias zonas afectadas. En Aranjuez es tan alarmante, que las reposiciones de nuevas plantas son constantes a pesar de los tratamientos llevados a cabo. Han incluido incluso unos paneles explicando esta realidad y los tratamientos que allí se realizan. En mi caso, procedo a una eliminación manual de todas las orugas y cápsulas tejidas en cuanto detecto las primeras y posteriormente realizo un sulfatado. Uno de mis bojes que estaba plantado cerca de otros afectados tiene plantado alrededor de él lavanda, famosa por ser un gran repelente natural de las polillas. Ese ejemplar no se ha visto afectado por orugas. To monitor her growth, I started weighing and measuring her a few months back at a two months' interval. The last reading on 29.4.2020 was 337 gm., carapace: 13 cm, plastron: 10 cm. Two previous readings taken on 28.2.2020 and 25.12.1019 were both 240 gm., carapace: 12 cm, plastron: 9 cm. Hence, I am a little concerned about this drastic weight gain of 97 gm. in two months! Could she be carrying eggs or does she possibly have other health problems? 🤔
I have been feeding her every day using the "head size" method. Her diet mainly consists of 50% turtle pellets, 50% fresh food consisting of fish, scallops, clams, egg white, corn, salad greens (although she didn't like salad greens up until a few weeks ago). 😋
Due to my space-tight environment, she has been kept in a relatively small tank in deep water indoors, but I do take her out to parks and streams every now and then. She's a good swimmer and a good walker. She has taken me by surprise the other day walking some 300 metres in 1.5 hours in a straight line on a jogging track in our local park (on 17.4.2020)! 🤭
Have I done anything wrong with her diet/its frequencies? Is there an explanation for her sudden weight gain? How could I tell if she's an adolescent or a mature adult, if she's ready to lay eggs and what do I need to do preparing her for it? a) Damals wurde noch Paarhaltung empfohlen. Gottseidank weisen Eure Videos ja häufig darauf hin, dass davon abzuraten ist; denn das ist für das Weibchen mit sexueller Dauerbelastung verbunden.

b) Wer eine faktisch zahme Schildkröte will (die dann z. B. auf panikartiges Verschwinden aus dem Sonnenbereich verzichtet), dem empfehle ich im Konrad-Lorenz-Stil eine (farbige) Keramikschildkröte zur Überwindung der Scheu. Schon Ernst Jünger wusste, dass Schildkröten sich ungemein gerne unter der Kehle streicheln lassen. Der absolute Lieblingsplatz - wie bei den Ohnmachtsanfällen der Drachen in "Drachenzähmen leichtgemacht" - ist jedoch die Hirnschale, die in Richtung Panzer sanft "gerubbelt" werden soll (ausser in Häutungszeiten).

c) Warum sollte man eine Schildkröte so zähmen? Weil man dann selbst die Schildkrötensprache erlernt (Nicken für absolutes Wohlbefinden, denn er schaut gerne Filme mit spärlicher Handlung, aber viel Wasser und Sand, wildes Halsschleudern  ("Verneinen") für "Halte Abstand!"-Signal, Schnauben und wildes Planschen zur morgendlichen Begrüssung usw.

d) Ein Tierarzt hatte mir vor 25 Jahren empfohlen, dass ich ihn einmal pro Woche mit Käse (LIeblingsspeise: Gauda und Tilsiter) füttern soll. Auf Flusskrebse, Sepia usw. sprach er von Anfang an nicht an.

e) Für mich ist diese Schildkröte (Stichprobe = 1, aber Langzeitstudie 🙃) der Beweis, dass die Intelligenz mit dem Alter massiv zunimmt (These: Panzer als entscheidender Faktor für die hohe Lebenserwartung - da z. I want as many fish as possible taking out of my pond so you are welcome to come if you've got the gear. | Definitely large pond / lake as they will suffer from elevated temperatures and picky diet indoors. | Would you say perch are more suitable for a pond or a tank? Comprei também um aquário mais alto para poder colocar um filtro, mas quero ter a certeza de que as tartarugas têm as melhores condições, dentro dos possíveis (já que o melhor seria não ter financiado quem as retira do seu habitat natural). Enfim, não consigo encontrar nenhum site ou fórum com informações específicas, e tenho medo que as lojas de animais da zona me tentem enganar com produtos caros e desnecessários, mas o André pareceu-me ter bastante conhecimento sobre esta espécie. Importa-se que eu lhe faça algumas perguntas, para as quais ninguém parece ter resposta? 1. Qual a quantidade de comida que devo dar (e quantas vezes por dia/semana), sendo que, pelo menos uma delas, tem um ano? (A outra, a dona da loja não me soube dizer, mas eu tive que a trazer, pois era a última e estava numa tartarugueira de plástico sem sequer uma zona seca e inundada de camarões) 2. A segunda também é relacionada a comida, visto que me disseram que a comida de supermercado não era adequada de todo, mas lá está, tenho medo que o vendedor me esteja a tentar enganar com os seus produtos. Quero frisar que, caso a comida mais cara seja a melhor, irei comprar com toda a certeza. Entretanto, tenho dado sticks da marca Dr. Wu, camarões de veeez em quando e fruta, mas li que devia incluir carne e peixe frescos também. Quais e em que quantidade? 3. Em relação ao aquário (antigo, que ainda estou a utilizar), como o tenho ao lado da janela e recebe luz regularmente, não tenho termostato. Tenho é uma lâmpada UVB que não estou a usar no momento porque fundiu. No entanto, comprei um filtro, que vou colocar assim que consiga uma zona seca apropriada e ao nível da água que vou ter que acrescentar devido ao aparelho, no aquário novo. De resto, tenho pedras no fundo, uma pedra de cálcio e a rampa que estava incluída no aquário. O aquário que comprei é mais alto e não tem rampa, por isso é que elas estão ainda no antigo. Quais as melhores decorações, os aparelhos mais indicados, o que posso improvisar para a zona seca, etc? Peço desculpa por este texto, mas tentei dar todas as informações possíveis para ser bem esclarecida. Como deve imaginar, quero proporcionar-lhes saúde, felicidade e um bom habitat. Muito obrigada! :)
